atoms.exact_source_text: It may become a minor Refuge, lookout, garden, or civic Place when fictionally appropriate.
atoms.normalized_claim: A vacant House may become a minor Refuge, lookout, garden, or civic Place when fictionally appropriate.

atoms.exact_source_text: It may be adapted for a compatible future Guest through a visible Project.
atoms.normalized_claim: A vacant House may be adapted for a compatible future Guest through a visible Project.
A vacant House may be deliberately dismantled.

atoms.exact_source_text: but never disappears automatically as a consumed recruitment token
atoms.normalized_claim: A vacant House never disappears automatically as a consumed recruitment token.

atoms.exact_source_text: An Expedition Guest may become Resident after maiming, age, or choice if a complete Home package is authored for that life.
atoms.normalized_claim: An Expedition Guest may become Resident after maiming, age, or choice, provided a complete Home package is authored for that life.

atoms.exact_source_text: The classification change preserves name, relationships, House history, and Memories.
atoms.normalized_claim: The classification change from Expedition Guest to Resident preserves name, relationships, House history, and Memories.

atoms.exact_source_text: It does not reset the Citizen into a new unit.
atoms.normalized_claim: The classification change does not reset the Citizen into a new unit.

atoms.exact_source_text: The full roster is wider than any one Colony should normally house.
atoms.normalized_claim: The full Guest roster is wider than any one Colony should normally house.

atoms.exact_source_text: Scarcity is valuable because each act of hospitality should alter the settlement and its relationships.
atoms.normalized_claim: Scarcity is valuable because each act of hospitality should alter the settlement and its relationships.

atoms.exact_source_text: The game must not convert that scarcity into rarity colors, completion anxiety, or optimal loadout collection.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game must not convert Guest scarcity into rarity colors, completion anxiety, or optimal loadout collection.

atoms.exact_source_text: Campaigns encounter more named outsiders than they ultimately welcome.
atoms.normalized_claim: Campaigns encounter more named outsiders than they ultimately welcome as Guests.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Guest may remain a recurring ally, neighbor, rival, visitor, Metropolis resident, or Citizen of another Colony.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Guest may remain a recurring ally, neighbor, rival, visitor, Metropolis resident, or Citizen of another Colony.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Guest is strictly superior in a linear tier ladder.
atoms.normalized_claim: No Guest is strictly superior in a linear tier ladder.

atoms.exact_source_text: No essential route, crop, defense, or ending requires one particular Guest.
atoms.normalized_claim: No essential route, crop, defense, or ending requires one particular Guest.

atoms.exact_source_text: A no-Guest campaign remains fully viable at every Colony Tier.
atoms.normalized_claim: A no-Guest campaign remains fully viable at every Colony Tier.
